# Three.js

Pinned browser ES modules from **three@0.180.0**, distributed under the MIT license
in `LICENSE`. Both modules are served locally; the experience does not contact a
CDN at runtime.

Sources: https://unpkg.com/three@0.180.0/build/three.module.js and
https://unpkg.com/three@0.180.0/build/three.core.js.
